ELU · EXPECTED COMPLETION

10 mm² Cable Upgrading Work (Unit Work)

Live Block Board status and confirmed appointment dates. Zone 1 and Zone 3 are excluded.

4 time slots per team each working dayConfirmed pink bookings reserve their actual date and slot; free gaps can be used for NR/P estimates. Sundays excluded.

Working estimate only. Done % follows the Meeting Report: completed / total units. Balance % is (NR + P) / total units. Empty slots in not-started blocks are forecast capacity, not booked appointments. Active closeout blocks with fewer than 10 NR are almost completed; their unbooked follow-up does not push the main target. Confirmed pink appointments keep their dates.
